Thanks Rachel / Jordan — read the draft this AM. High-level: the listing tells a clear story but there are a few operational and compliance tweaks Id make to improve co-sell discoverability and reduce back-and-forth with AWS. Ive pasted inline recommendations and a short proposed hero + bullets below.

Inline guidance (high priority):
- Replace "state-of-the-art" in hero with a measurable claim or remove — AWS review flags superlatives without evidence.
- Trial language: include explicit trial length and what counts as usage to avoid billing disputes (example: "14-day trial, includes up to 10k inference tokens per user").
- Data residency line: if Acme plans to use our Private option they should specify region(s) in the asset checklist.

Proposed hero (short):
"Redwood-powered inference for analytics teams — predictable latency and transparent cost per token, with turnkey AWS Marketplace delivery."

Proposed bullets (feature / co-sell friendly):
- "High-throughput text generation tuned for analytics workflows (logs, summaries, entity extraction) — benchmarked to p95 latency of Xms on c6gn-class instances."
- "Transparent pricing & trial: 14-day free trial (up to 10k tokens/user) + per-token billing post-trial."
- "Enterprise-ready: Dedicated capacity and VPC-private deployment options; integrates with customer KMS for key management."

Ops checklist items for Acme to confirm (send to marketplace-support):
1) AMI / container registry image name + digest
2) SKU & entitlement mapping for trial units
3) Logo + screenshot assets in required sizes (see CSV)
4) Support contact and escalation email for co-sell handoffs

I attached a light edit of the draft (redwood_marketplace_listing_draft.md) with tracked suggestions. Rafael — would you review the suggested evidence claims and add any required customer citations or bench summaries?

-Kim
Kimberly Park
Senior Product Marketing Manager, GTM Enablement
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_marketplace_listing_draft.md (edited version)

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 10:22:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Initial pass: AWS listing setup & product page copy

Jordan / team — quick legal/field note from my side: the proposed hero and bullets above are a good start. A couple of asks before we publish:

1) Evidence: for the latency claim include a one-line citation and a link to the internal benchmark doc (I added a short footnote placeholder: "p95 latency ~120ms on g5.2xlarge; internal benchmark id: INF-BMK-2026-78"). If Acme wants public-facing claims we need a signed data use consent or a customer quote in the assets.

2) Pricing footnote: avoid using the phrase "transparent cost per token" without an explicit billing example in the pricing section. Suggest adding a short sample invoice line item for a 10k-token request.

3) MOU / co-sell entitlement: I reviewed the MOU summary Acme attached. For Marketplace co-sell opt-in we need the finalized addendum signed by Jan 5 to meet AWS co-sell certification timelines. Jordan — can your legal team confirm? If yes, well route DocuSign (I can prep).

Next steps I propose:
- Jordan: confirm legal signoff on the MOU addendum by EoD Dec 17 (or earlier if possible).
- Rachel/Kim: finalize copy edits by Dec 15, then we submit to AWS for listing review.

Jordan — happy to draft the DocuSign if you confirm who signs on Acmes side.

Thanks,
Rafael Mendes
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
